# BlackDrivo

> BlackDrivo is a premium chauffeur / black car service operating across New York, New Jersey, and nationwide in the United States, and a car rental and driver service across Pakistan (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad).

## Services
- Airport transfers at 30+ major US airports (JFK, LGA, EWR, LAX, ORD, and more) and at Lahore (LHE), Karachi (KHI), and Islamabad (ISB) in Pakistan — flight tracking included, complimentary wait time (60 min domestic / 90 min international), fixed pricing, meet & greet available.
- Chauffeur/driver service (point-to-point rides) in 40+ US cities and in Lahore, Karachi, and Islamabad, Pakistan.
- City-to-city rides, including Lahore–Islamabad, Karachi–Hyderabad, and other Pakistan routes.
- Hourly and per-day car/chauffeur rental packages for multi-stop trips and events.
- Monthly Pick & Drop: a fixed monthly plan for recurring daily rides (school runs, office commutes) with the same driver each day — available in Lahore, Karachi, and Islamabad.
- Corporate/B2B travel accounts: dedicated account manager, route-wise fixed billing, monthly consolidated invoicing, and scheduled recurring pick-drop.
- Travel Agent program: agent-only discounted rates for booking client rides on their behalf, with consolidated monthly invoicing.
- On-Demand bookings: instant, fixed-price car rental, airport pickup & drop, and city-to-city rides with no schedule or account required.
- Limousine service.

## Pricing model
Fares are fixed at the time of booking based on route and vehicle class. There is no surge pricing — the price shown at booking is the price charged, regardless of traffic, weather, or demand.

## Fleet
Economy, Business Class, and First Class sedans; executive luxury SUVs; vans, buses, and coaches; Event Vehicles (Coaster, Grand Cabin, Mini Van) for weddings and corporate events; and specialty vehicles including stretch limousines and vintage classics.

## Coverage
Primary US markets: New York and New Jersey. Also available nationwide across the United States, including 30+ airports and 40+ cities for chauffeur service. BlackDrivo is also available across Pakistan, covering Lahore, Karachi, and Islamabad (see https://www.blackdrivo.com/pk).

## Booking
Rides can be booked through the BlackDrivo website (blackdrivo.com) or the BlackDrivo mobile app (iOS and Android).
